832b9: It is said that this [animal] changes the colours of its hair
832b10: according to whichever place it happens to be in. And on account of this it is hard to catch
832b11: [and because of the change]; for also in trees and in places,
832b14: The rest as to colour, such as the chameleon and the octopus.
832b15: As for size, it is like an ox. As for the shape of its face,
832b16: similar: it has a likeness to a deer.
